verdict.rationale: Forms and validation are a fair question for a UI library's ecosystem, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no first-party form-building or validation modules. The only related item is a generic mention of updating the screen when a user types into an input, which is an adjacent feature, not form tooling.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use first-party modules for building and validating forms that integrate with the rest of the framework
